report:
Cervix, liquid-based cytology

Received is one liquid-based cytology vial, processed as one slide.

The liquid-based preparation is satisfactory for evaluation, with an endocervical/transformation zone component present, and shows reactive cellular changes associated with inflammation. HPV testing: negative for high-risk HPV. There is no intraepithelial lesion or malignancy.

CERVIX, liquid-based cytology - NEGATIVE FOR INTRAEPITHELIAL LESION OR MALIGNANCY (NILM)
